title: Insight editor auto-saves (PATCH) on chart-type change: scene-instance guard must use insightId/dashboardId, not insightLogicRef
answers: why does the insight save itself when I change chart type
insight editor exits edit mode and shows 'Insight updated' without clicking Save
how does persistDisplayOptions decide whether to PATCH the insight
isInsightSceneInstance returns wrong value right after opening editor
body:
Symptom: In the insight editor, picking a new chart type saves the insight without the user clicking Save. The editor leaves edit mode and shows "Insight updated" within about a second. It is an intermittent race that is hard to reproduce.
Root cause: frontend/src/scenes/insights/insightDataLogic.tsx:isInsightSceneInstance compared the props key against insightSceneLogic's `insightLogicRef`. A separate listener sets that ref by rebuilding and mounting a new logic, so it can still be stale right after the scene mounts. persistDisplayOptions then treated the editor's instance as a non-scene instance and sent a PATCH.
Fix pattern: Compare against the reducers `insightSceneLogic.values.insightId` and `dashboardId`, which the URL-matching action sets synchronously. Match `insightId === props.dashboardItemId`, and match `dashboardId` with null and undefined treated as equal (`?? null`). Keep the check that `sceneLogic.values.activeSceneId === Scene.Insight`.
Constraints: In kea scene logics, a `*LogicRef` that a listener builds is not a reliable source for synchronous guards. Use the reducer values that drive it. To regression-test, mock `insightSceneLogic.findMounted` so it returns `{ values: { insightId, dashboardId, insightLogicRef: null } }`. Then assert that the PATCH spy is not called after `persistDisplayOptions` (see the `persistDisplayOptions` describe block in insightDataLogic.test.ts).
applies: Frontend insight editor save/persist guards in insightDataLogic and anything that reads state from insightSceneLogic
